# Architecture Requirements Quality Checklist: Target Architecture

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, clarity, completeness, and consistency of the SPEC-0003
Target Architecture requirements before implementation. This is a unit test for the
requirements writing, not a verification of any implementation.
**Created**: 2026-08-06
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

- [ ] CHK006 Are the Jobs project responsibilities (SMS queue, email queue, scheduled reports) fully specified? [Completeness, Spec §5, FR-008]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the Identity integration point requirement defined? [Completeness, Spec §5, FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the EF Core DbContext requirement over the existing `VisaEntry` database stated? [Completeness, Spec §5, FR-006]
